scientific_integrity: A self-contained probability proof gives the infinite-family statement. The finite checker provides corroboration only, not a substitute for proof. No third-party audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The conclusion is specific to uniform random edge priorities on the crown graph; it does not cover arbitrary missing-edge patterns or deposition rates. The full text of two older broad matching/adsorption papers was inaccessible during the comparison. No independent validation has been performed.
title: Sharp \(2/n\) rare-jamming law for random dimers on crown graphs
